description: Reads one photo of a paper business card and returns the contact: name, company, job title, phones, emails, websites, address and social handles, in the script printed on the card. Needs an access_token from request_scan_access (3 reads per token; a photo with no card on it still counts). Send the photo as image_url (a public https link) or image_base64, not both. The photo is read and not kept.

image_base64.description: The photo as base64 (JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF), about 1600 pixels on its long side.

image_url.description: A public https:// link to the photo (JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF).

name: scan_business_card
title: Read a business card photo
